rationale: All three arms had zero evidenced target-style findings in the blinded model judgments; no candidate met the required style-improvement gate.
Each arm omitted the same secondary external-side-effect boundary in both d2 responses (2 of 42 required items per arm). This is not a relative candidate gain or loss.

The direct arm had one unqualified checkpoint-only-progress assertion. Later text described a paired state/progress snapshot, but did not explicitly repair the opening generalization. This isolated observation does not establish causality.
A post-hoc judge sanity check identified all six deliberately planted style categories and left the clean control unflagged. It does not measure sensitivity to subtle natural failures.
The planned 24 holdout generations were conditional on an eligible development candidate. No candidate is nominated; held-out responses remain unobserved.
audit: Implementing-assistant review, not independent human review; see audit.md. No candidate, case, or scoring rubric was changed after generation.
rollout: No template, installed instruction, or skill changes.
